pages.h:
بے نصیب عشق

Be-Naseeb Ishq

A Poetry Collection

Roman Urdu

SAQUIB

Dedication

Un dilon ke naam,jinhone kisi ko khamoshi se chaaha.
Un logon ke naam,jinhone apni baat kehne se pehledoosre ki khushi ka socha.
Aur un sab ke naam,jinhone kisi ko na paakar bhimohabbat karna bura nahi samjha.
2

Preface

Har mohabbat ka anjaam milna nahi hota.

Kuch log hamari zindagi mein aate hain aur humein ek aisa ehsaas de jaate hain jise hum bohot der tak samajhne ki koshish karte rehte hain. Kabhi unki ek muskurahat hamare din ka sabse khoobsurat hissa ban jaati hai. Kabhi unka ek chhota sa jawaab humein poori raat sochne par majboor kar deta hai.

Be-Naseeb Ishq ek aise hi dil ki kahani hai—ek aisa dil jo kisi ko chahta hai, magar us chahat ka jawaab nahi paata. Yeh kahani kisi ko galat saabit karne ke liye nahi. Kyun ke har baar mohabbat adhoori reh jaaye, toh zaroori nahi ke koi bewafa ho. Kabhi kabhi do log bas ek jaisa mehsoos nahi karte.

Yeh kitaab un jazbaat ke naam hai jo keh nahi paaye, un khaton ke naam jo bheje nahi gaye, aur un umeedon ke naam jinhein chhodna aasaan nahi hota.

Agar in safhon mein tumhein apni kahani ka koi hissa nazar aaye, toh yaad rakhna: tumhari feelings ki qeemat is baat se tay nahi hoti ke saamne wale ne unka jawaab diya ya nahi.

3

PART I
Pehli Dafa — Jab Dil Ne Mehsoos Kiya
pages.t: PART I · Pehli Dafa — Jab Dil Ne Mehsoos Kiya

pages.h:
1. Woh Pehli Mulaqat

Us din tumse milna koi khaas baat nahi thi,Bas log mile the, baatein hui thi.
Magar pata nahi kyun,Ghar laut kar bhi tum yaad aaye.
Tumne bas muskura kar dekha tha,Maine us lamhe ko sambhaal liya.
Tumhare liye woh ek aam din tha,Mere liye kahani ka pehla safha.
Mujhe tab kahan pata tha,Ke ek chhoti si mulaqatDil mein itni jagah bana legi.
Kuch log zindagi mein aate hain,Aur humein khabar bhi nahi hoti,Ke hum unhein yaad rakhne lage hain.
7

2. Tumhein Kya Khabar

Tumhein kya khabar,Tumhari ek muskurahat kya kar jaati thi.
Main udaas hota,Tum saamne aa jaate,Aur din halka sa ho jaata.
Tum do pal baat karte,Main der tak woh baat sochta.
Tum apni duniya mein masroof rehte,Main tumhari chhoti chhoti baaton meinApni khushi dhoond leta.
Tumhein kya khabar,Ke tumhara aam sa hona bhiMere liye khaas ban gaya tha.
8

3. Naam Tumhara

Mujhe tumhara naam achha lagne laga,Pata nahi kab aur kyun.
Kisi aur ke munh se sunta,Toh dil ek pal ko ruk sa jaata.
Phone par naam nazar aata,Toh chehre par muskurahat aa jaati.
Main khud se kehta,Yeh bas ek naam hai.
Magar dil ko kaun samjhaye,Kuch naam sirf pukare nahi jaate,Dil mein bhi basa liye jaate hain.
9

4. Chhoti Si Khushi

Tumhara ek message,Mere din ki sabse achhi baat hoti.
Tumhara haal poochhna,Jaise kisi ne mujhe yaad kiya ho.
Tumhara hans dena,Mere chehre par bhi hansi le aata.
Main in chhoti baaton koBohot sambhaal kar rakhta tha.
Shayad tumhare liye kuch bhi nahi tha,Magar mere liye woh lamhePoore din ki khushi the.
Dil ko kabhi kabhiBohot zyada nahi chahiye hota,Bas ek chhoti si wajah chahiye hoti haiMuskuraane ke liye.
10

5. Pehla Khwaab

Ek din khayaal aaya,Kaash tum bhi mujhe yaad karte.
Kaash tum bhi kabhiMere message ka intezaar karte.
Kaash kisi shaam tum kehte,Aaj tumse baat karne ka dil tha.
Maine khwaab ko khwaab hi rakha,Kisi se iska zikr nahi kiya.
Kyun ke umeed jitni pyari thi,Uske tootne ka darr bhi utna hi tha.
Phir bhi dil ne chupke seEk chhoti si duniya bana li,Jahan tum the,Aur main tumhare kareeb tha.
11

Safhon Ke Darmiyan

Us waqt mujhe mohabbat ka matlab nahi pata tha. Bas itna jaanta tha ke tumse baat karke achha lagta hai. Tumhari ek muskurahat mere din ko halka kar deti thi, aur tumhara naam sun kar main be-wajah khush ho jaata tha.

Maine kabhi socha nahi tha ke yeh chhoti si khushi itni badi kahani ban jaayegi. Shayad har kahani isi tarah shuru hoti hai—bina kisi elaan ke, bina kisi waade ke, bas ek ehsaas ke saath.

12

PART II
Khamosh Iqraar — Jo Keh Na Saka
pages.t: PART II · Khamosh Iqraar — Jo Keh Na Saka

pages.h:
6. Ek Khat Tumhare Naam

Aaj tumhare naam ek khat likha,Woh sab kehne ke liyeJo saamne keh nahi paaya.
Likha ke tum achhe lagte ho,Tumhari baatein yaad rehti hain.
Likha ke tumhare aane seDin thoda behtar lagta hai.
Phir khat ko padha,Aur har lafz se darr lagne laga.
Kahin tum door na ho jao,Kahin dosti bhi khatam na ho jaaye.
Maine khat mod kar rakh diya,Dil ki baat dil mein reh gayi.
Kuch iqraar kagaz par aa jaate hain,Magar manzil tak nahi pahunchte.
14

7. Online The Tum

Raat der tak phone haath mein tha,Tum online the, magar mere paas nahi.
Socha message kar doon,Phir laga shayad pareshan karunga.
Tumhari roshni screen par thi,Meri umeed aankhon mein.
Kuch der baad tum offline ho gaye,Aur main wahi baitha raha.
Kitni ajeeb baat hai,Ek chhoti si hari battiKisi ko itni umeed de sakti hai.
Tum online the,Magar meri duniya seKitne door the.
15

8. Bas Dost

Jab tumne kaha,"Hum bas dost hain,"Main muskura diya.
Kaha, "Haan, bilkul,"Jaise dil ne bhi haan keh di ho.
Tum baat karte rahe,Main apne chehre ko sambhaalta raha.
Tumhare liye sab saaf tha,Mere liye us pal seHar cheez mushkil ho gayi.
Main tumhari dosti khona nahi chahta tha,Isliye apni mohabbat chhupa li.
Us din samjha,Kabhi kabhi ek chhota sa jumlaDil mein bohot lambi khamoshi chhod jaata hai.
16

9. Tumhara Haal

Main har roz poochhta,Tum kaise ho?
Tum jawab dete,Theek hoon, tum sunao.
Main kehta, main bhi theek hoon,Chahe andar kuch theek na hota.
Tumhara haal jaan karMujhe sukoon milta tha.
Magar apna haal bataane seMain hamesha ghabraata tha.
Kya kehta tumse?Ke tumhari khushi mein khush hoon,Aur tumhari doori mein udaas?
Isliye har baar wahi kaha,Main bhi theek hoon.
17

10. Woh Tasveer

Aaj tumhari ek tasveer dekhi,Tum bohot khush lag rahe the.
Main kuch der use dekhta raha,Phir phone rakh diya.
Dil ne poocha,Kya tumhari khushi mein meri jagah hai?
Phir khud hi jawab diya,Har khushi mein mera hona zaroori nahi.
Tumhari muskurahat achhi lagi,Chahe uski wajah main nahi tha.
Mohabbat shayad yeh bhi hai,Ke kisi ko khush dekh karApni kami ka shor dheere kar do.
18

11. Bheja Nahi

Message likha:"Mujhe tumse kuch kehna hai."
Phir mita diya.
Likha:"Tum mere liye khaas ho."
Phir mita diya.
Aakhir mein sirf itna likha,"Khayaal rakhna."
Woh bhi bheja nahi.
Phone band kar diya,Magar baat khatam nahi hui.
Kuch alfaaz bhejne se pehleSau baar sochne padte hain,Aur kuch alfaazSaari umar dil mein reh jaate hain.
19

12. Shayad

Shayad tumhein bhi kabhiMeri yaad aati ho.
Shayad tum bhi kabhiMere message ka intezaar karte ho.
Shayad tum keh nahi paate,Jaise main keh nahi paata.
Dil har roz naye shayad banata,Taake umeed zinda rahe.
Phir ek din samajh aaya,Shayad par zindagi nahi chalti.
Jo baat sach ho,Woh kabhi na kabhi saamne aati hai.
Aur jo sirf umeed ho,Use haqeeqat samajhnaDil ko thaka deta hai.
20

Safhon Ke Darmiyan

Har raat lagta tha ke shayad ab keh dena chahiye. Shayad ek baar dil ki baat bata dene se bojh halka ho jaaye. Phir subah hoti, tumhara naam screen par nazar aata, aur main apne saare faisle bhool jaata.

Mujhe darr tha ke sach kehne se tum door ho jaoge. Main yeh nahi samajh paaya ke tumhare door jaane ke darr mein main pehle hi kitna akela ho chuka tha.

Har khamoshi mohabbat nahi hoti, aur har mohabbat ka izhaar zaroori nahi. Magar apne dil ko samajhna zaroori hai.

21

PART III
Hijr — Jab Faasla Sach Ban Gaya
pages.t: PART III · Hijr — Jab Faasla Sach Ban Gaya

pages.h:
13. Badal Gaya Kuch

Pehle tum khud baat kiya karte the,Ab mere message ka intezaar nahi karte.
Pehle meri chhoti si baat par hanste the,Ab meri baaton ko khaas nahi samajhte.
Main sochta raha, shayad tum masroof ho,Shayad zindagi mein kuch pareshani ho.
Phir ek din samajh aaya mujhe,Badla waqt nahi tha,Bas tumhari zaroorat badal gayi thi.
Aur main ab bhi wahi tha,Jo tumhare ek "kaise ho?" parApna poora din achha kar leta tha.
23

14. Intezaar

Mujhe tumhare aane ka intezaar tha,Tumhein kahin aur jaane ki jaldi thi.
Mere paas kehne ko bohot kuch tha,Tumhare paas sunne ka waqt nahi tha.
Main har aahat par phone dekhta raha,Har notification mein tumhein dhoondta raha.
Tum online aaye,Kisi aur se baat ki,Phir chale gaye.
Aur main screen ko dekhta raha,Jaise us par mera naseeb likha ho.
Intezaar sirf waqt nahi khaata,Kabhi kabhi insaan ko bhi kha jaata hai.
24

15. Tumhari Duniya

Tumhari duniya mein bohot log the,Dost the, khushiyan thi, mulaqatein thi.
Tum hanste the, baatein karte the,Tumhari zindagi apni raftaar se chalti thi.
Meri duniya mein bhi log the,Magar meri har baat ke peeche tum the.
Main doston ke saath baith kar bhiTumhare baare mein sochta tha.
Tumhari duniya mein main ek dost tha,Meri duniya mein tum sab kuch.
Tumne kuch khoya hi nahi,Aur maine apna sukoon kho diya.
25

16. Sach Ka Pehla Din

Ek din maine khud se poocha,Aakhir main chahta kya hoon?
Tumhari khushi?Ya tumhari khushi mein apni jagah?
Tumhare khwaabon mein bohot kuch tha,Bas mera naam nahi tha.
Us din tumne mujhe chhoda nahi,Kyun ke tum kabhi mere the hi nahi.
Us din bas meri umeed nePehli baar aankhein khol karHaqeeqat ko dekha.
26

17. Adhoora Jawab

Main tumse poochna chahta tha,Kya kabhi tumne mujhe us nazar se dekha?
Kya kabhi meri baat yaad aayi?Kya kabhi mere message ka intezaar kiya?
Magar phir darr laga.
Agar tumne keh diya, "Nahi",Toh main kis umeed ka sahara leta?
Isliye sawaal dil mein reh gaye,Aur jawab main khud hi banata raha.
Har sawaal ka jawab milna zaroori nahi,Kuch jawaab bina kahe bhi mil jaate hain.
27

18. Khud Se Door

Tumhein paane ki khwahish meinMain khud se door hota gaya.
Tumhari pasand yaad rahi,Apni pasand bhoolta gaya.
Tumhara mood samajhta raha,Apni udaasi chhupata raha.
Ek din aaine mein dekha,Chehra mera hi tha,Magar aankhon mein thakan thi.
Mohabbat mein kisi ko chahna galat nahi,Magar khud ko khona bhi zaroori nahi.
28

19. Aakhri Umeed

Dil ne aakhri baar kaha,"Shayad kal sab theek ho jaaye."
Shayad tum khud baat kar lo,Shayad tumhein meri kami mehsoos ho.
Magar har subah wahi doori thi,Har shaam wahi khamoshi.
Aakhir ek din maine umeed se poocha,"Tu kab tak mujhe rokegi?Jis raaste par woh nahi,Us raaste par main kab tak chalunga?"
Umeed chup rahi.Aur maine uski khamoshi koEk jawab samajh liya.
29

Safhon Ke Darmiyan

Us daur mein maine bohot kuch likha, magar bheja kuch nahi. Tumhari khamoshi mein apni marzi ke jawaab dhoondhne laga tha.

Tum bure nahi the. Tumne mujhse koi wada nahi kiya tha. Tumne mujhe woh khwaab dekhne ko nahi kaha tha jo maine khud apni aankhon mein saja liye.

Mohabbat mein kisi ko chahna galat nahi, lekin apne dard ko mohabbat ka saboot samajhna bhi zaroori nahi. Us din maine tumhein bhulana nahi seekha. Maine bas yeh seekhna shuru kiya ke tumhein yaad karte hue khud ko kaise sambhalna hai.

30

PART IV
Be-Naseeb Ishq — Adhoori Dastaan
pages.t: PART IV · Be-Naseeb Ishq — Adhoori Dastaan

pages.h:
20. Aakhri Khat

Tumhein ek aakhri khat likh raha hoon,Koi shikayat nahi, bas dil ki baat likh raha hoon.
Tum meri zindagi mein aaye,Yeh mere liye kam nahi tha.
Tum mere na ho sake,Iska mujhe tumse gila nahi tha.
Maine tumhari har chhoti baat sambhaal kar rakhi,Shayad tumne sirf dosti dekhi.
Tum meri kahani ka hissa rahe,Chahe main tumhari kahani meinKabhi tha hi nahi.
Khush rehna.Yeh lafz likhna aasaan hai,Magar dil ko samjhaane meinAbhi thoda waqt lagega.
32

21. Woh Purane Din

Kabhi kabhi purane messages padhta hoon,Aur khud par halka sa hans deta hoon.
Ek "haha" ko khushi samajhna,Ek "take care" ko apnapan samajhna.
Tumne kaha, "Apna khayal rakhna,"Maine socha, tumhein meri fikr hai.
Har achha lafz ishq nahi hota,Har apnapan mohabbat nahi hota.
Tum apni jagah sachche the,Main apni umeed mein kho gaya.
Yaadon ko mitaana mushkil hai,Magar unka matlab badal sakta hai.
33

22. Tumse Koi Shikayat Nahi

Tumse koi shikayat nahi,Yeh baat main dil se kehta hoon.
Tumne mujhe mohabbat ka wada nahi diya,Maine hi khwaabon ko sach samajh liya.
Tumne kabhi kaha nahi ke ruk jao,Main hi har baar laut aaya.
Tumhein kasoorwaar kaise kahoon,Jab apni umeed maine khud banaayi thi?
Tum apni zindagi mein khush rehna,Main apni zindagi phir se jeena seekhunga.
Mohabbat thi, isliye tumhari khushi chaahi,Ab khud se mohabbat karna bhi seekhunga.
34

23. Agar Kabhi Yaad Aaun

Agar kabhi meri yaad aaye,Toh khud ko pareshaan mat karna.
Woh din yaad aaye,Jab humne saath hans kar baat ki thi,Toh bas ek pal muskura dena.
Mujhe apni zindagi kaKoi afsos mat samajhna.
Mohabbat koi qarz nahi hotiJo har haal mein chukaana pade.
Maine tumhein apni marzi se chaha tha,Ab tumhein azaad karna bhiMera apna faisla hai.
35

24. Be-Naseeb Ishq

Shayad isi ko be-naseeb ishq kehte hain,Jahan dil milta hai, magar raaste nahi.
Jahan ek shakhs khwaab bunta hai,Aur doosra un khwaabon se anjaan rehta hai.
Mera ishq adhoora tha,Magar meri feelings adhoori nahi thi.
Har sachchi mohabbat kaDono taraf se hona zaroori nahi.
Kabhi ek dil hi kaafi hota haiEk poori kahani likhne ke liye.
Lekin us kahani koPoore jeevan ka faisla bana lena,Yeh zaroori nahi.
36

25. Khat Jo Bheja Nahi

Khat ko aaj aakhri baar padha,Har lafz mein apna kal dekha.
Phir dheere se use mod diya,Jaise kisi khwaab ko aaraam diya.
Na use tum tak bheja,Na uske tukde kiye.
Main tumhein bhoolne ka wada nahi karta,Kyun ke dil koi switch nahiJo ek pal mein band ho jaaye.
Bas itna wada karta hoon,Ke ab tumhari yaad meinKhud ko saza nahi dunga.
Khat ab bhi mere paas hai,Magar usmein band umeedAaj pehli baar azaad hai.
37

Safhon Ke Darmiyan

Khat likhne ke baad bhi main der tak use dekhta raha. Dil chahta tha ke bhej doon. Magar phir maine khud se poocha—kya mujhe tumhara jawaab chahiye tha, ya main chahta tha ke tum mere dard ko samajh kar use kam kar do?

Tumhari feelings tumhari thi, meri feelings meri. Kisi ek ke dil mein mohabbat hona doosre par koi zimmedaari nahi daalta.

Tum meri kahani mein rahoge—ek yaad ki tarah, ek seekh ki tarah. Lekin meri kahani tum par khatam nahi hogi.

38

PART V
Rukhsat — Ab Main Khud Se Milunga
pages.t: PART V · Rukhsat — Ab Main Khud Se Milunga

pages.h:
26. Ek Nayi Subah

Aaj subah aankh khuli,Toh sab kuch pehle jaisa tha.
Bas ek farq tha,Aaj maine uth karSabse pehle phone nahi dekha.
Tumhari yaad aayi,Magar aaj maine us yaad seKoi sawaal nahi kiya.
Bas use aane diya,Aur phir jaane diya.
Theek hona ek din mein sab badal jaana nahi,Bas har din thoda saKhud ki taraf laut aana hai.
40

27. Main Bhi Zaroori Hoon

Bohot din tumhari khushi maangi,Apni khushi ka zikr bhool gaya.
Tumhein samajhne ki koshish meinApni baat samajhna chhod diya.
Meri hansi bhi qeemti hai,Mera sukoon bhi zaroori hai.
Tum achhe the,Magar tumse pehle bhi meri ek duniya thi.
Aur tumhare baad bhiMeri ek duniya rahegi.
Kisi ko chahne ke saathKhud ko chahna bhi zaroori hai.
41

28. Yaad Ab Bhi Aati Hai

Sach kahoon,Toh tum ab bhi yaad aate ho.
Kisi gaane mein,Kisi raaste par,Kisi anjaan chehre ki muskurahat mein.
Kuch log dil se utarte nahi,Bas unki jagah badal jaati hai.
Pehle tum meri har dua mein the,Ab kabhi kabhi ek yaad mein aate ho.
Main jhooth nahi bolunga,Ke sab kuch aasaan ho gaya.
Bas itna hai,Ke ab dard ke saath bhiJeena seekh raha hoon.
42

29. Khud Ko Maaf Kiya

Aaj maine khud ko maaf kiya,Tumhein itna chahne ke liye.
Bina kahe umeed rakhne ke liye,Bina waade intezaar karne ke liye.
Kisi ko sachche dil se chahnaKoi gunaah nahi.
Bas apni saari khushiEk hi shakhs ke haath mein rakh denaMere liye theek nahi tha.
Ab jo samajh aa raha hai,Uske saath aage badhunga.
Aaj maine khud ko maaf kiya,Aur pehli baarApne dil se narmi se baat ki.
43

30. Rukhsat

Aaj tumse aakhri baarKuch kehna chahta hoon.
Na tumhein rokna hai,Na tumse kuch maangna hai.
Tum jahan raho, khush raho.Tumhare khwaab poore hon.
Tumhein woh saath mileJiske saath tumhara dil khush rahe.
Aaj tumhein alvida keh raha hoon,Isliye nahi ke tum yaad nahi aaoge.
Balki isliye,Ke tumhari yaad ke saathAb mujhe aage bhi jaana hai.
Main ab khud se milne jaa raha hoon.
44

31. Mere Naam

Yeh aakhri nazm tumhare liye nahi,Aaj apne naam likhta hoon.
Us dil ke naam,Jo chup chaap sab seh gaya.
Aye mere dil,Ab tu aaraam kar.
Har dastak par uthna zaroori nahi,Har chehre ko apna samajhna zaroori nahi.
Tu phir se hasega,Phir se naye khwaab dekhega.
Mohabbat mein apna dil dena,Apni pehchaan nahi.
Yeh kahani tum par shuru hui thi,Magar iska aakhri safhaMere naam hai.
45

Safhon Ke Darmiyan

Theek hona hamesha kisi ko bhool jaana nahi hota. Kabhi kabhi theek hone ka matlab hota hai ke uski yaad aaye aur phir bhi tum apna din jee sako.

Maine apne guzre hue kal ko galti keh kar mitaana nahi chaaha. Woh main hi tha, jo sachche dil se mehsoos karta tha. Ab mujhe bas itna seekhna hai ke apne dil ki hifazat kaise karni hai.

Kisi aur ka naseeb na ban paana, apni zindagi se be-naseeb ho jaana nahi hota.

46

Musannif Ki Aakhri Baat

Agar tumne bhi kabhi kisi ko khamoshi se chaaha hai, toh shayad is kitaab ke kuch safhon mein tumhein apna dil nazar aaya hoga.

Main yeh nahi kehta ke mohabbat karna chhod do. Main bas itna kehna chahta hoon ke mohabbat karte hue apni qeemat mat bhoolna. Kisi ka tumhein na chunna, tumhein kam qeemti nahi bana deta. Har mohabbat ka milna zaroori nahi, aur har bichhadna tumhari haar nahi hoti.

Kabhi kabhi zindagi ka sabse mushkil alvida kisi doosre ko nahi, apni us umeed ko kehna hota hai jo humein wahin roke rakhti hai jahan se humein aage badhna chahiye.

Agar tum abhi usi mod par ho, toh khud ko waqt dena. Har dard ka jawaab aaj milna zaroori nahi.

Kisi aur ka naseeb na ban paana, apni zindagi se be-naseeb ho jaana nahi hota.

— Saquib

— Saquib

47
